label: Diagram 3.5
caption: Diagram 3.5 Multi-storey flat with alternative exits from each habitable room, except at entrance level
description:
The drawing, titled in a green bar at the bottom "Diagram 3.5 Multi-storey flat with alternative exits from each habitable room, except at entrance level", contains two floor plans, a legend, a note, and a reference "See para 3.21" at the top left.

Part a, labelled "Entrance level", is a plan of a flat divided into two rooms by a central wall. A door marked "Flat entrance" opens at the bottom. The left room shows a stair symbol and a "WC". Two green diagonal lines, each labelled "9m max.", run from the central door to the top-right and bottom-right corners.

Part b, labelled "Level(s) above or below entrance level", is a similar plan with a stair symbol on the left and a room labelled "Bathroom" on the right. The words "Exit" appear four times—at the top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right—each with a green arrow symbol pointing outwards.

On the right, a legend shows the green arrow symbol as "Alternative exit", and a NOTE reads: "This only applies where at least one storey is more than 4.5m above ground level."
